revised_prompt:
Create a clean high-resolution runtime flow diagram for a research agent platform rebuilt on LangGraph StateGraph.

Style: publication-quality systems flowchart, white background, crisp vector-like boxes, blue and slate palette, amber for approval gate, landscape layout, highly legible, minimal shadows, modern professional diagram.

Title at top: "Research Agent Platform: Runtime Logic"

Center the runtime engine prominently with a large box labeled "StateGraph" and nearby small labels "interrupt(...)" and "Command(resume=...)". Include a clearly visible "Checkpointer" connected to StateGraph.

Show a left-to-right execution path with arrows and boxes in this exact order:
User Command -> Intent Router -> Create TaskRun -> StateGraph.invoke(...) -> execute_stage_0 -> support context enrichment -> artifact generation -> approval_stage_0 interrupt(...) -> human review -> approve path -> resume with Command(resume=...) -> next stage -> finalize -> artifacts + wiki note + completed.

Also show a reject loop from human review / approval gate returning back to the same stage with feedback, labeled "reject + feedback".

Include exact labels somewhere in the diagram: "StateGraph", "interrupt(...)", "Command(resume=...)", "TaskRun JSON", "Artifact Manifest", "Checkpointer".

Show "TaskRun JSON" as an input/output data card near Create TaskRun. Show "Artifact Manifest" as an output card near artifact generation/finalize. Show "Checkpointer" as persistent storage beside StateGraph.

Use amber highlight for the approval gate / interrupt node, blue and slate for normal runtime nodes, with clear directional arrows. Make it look like a publication-ready architecture diagram or flowchart, not a cartoon. All labels in English. High resolution, crisp, highly legible, landscape orientation.
